newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arbed falls on news of small H1 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Arbed falls on news of small H1 1996 loss.

text.p: Shares in Luxembourg steelmaker Arbed fell 2.3 percent to 3,670 francs by 0845 GMT on the Brussels bourse on Wednesday after the company said late Tuesday it swung to a loss in the first half of 1996.
Arbed made a group loss of 249 million Luxembourg francs versus a 2.4 billion profit in the year-ago period.
"This result comes as no surprise to us but the short term prospects seem very weak," Generale Bank said in a research note. Others had forecast a small profit.
Several analysts said Arbed was cheap versus other European steel stocks, however, and should rise in the longer term.
